rooted.name: Rooted
rooted.reminder: It cannot be moved. It has +1 Hold in the Front row.

reach.name: Reach
reach.reminder: It also attacks from the Back row.

echo.name: Echo
echo.reminder: When it dies, a 1/1 copy returns to your hand.

wear.name: Wear
wear.reminder: It loses 1 Attack at each Dusk.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.reminder: The Tide does not move while it is in play.

surge.name: Surge
surge.reminder: It also attacks in the round it enters play.

highTide.name: High Tide
highTide.reminder: Active when the Tide is on your side by 2 or more.

lowTide.name: Ebb
lowTide.reminder: Active when the Tide is on the opponent's side by 2 or more.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.reminder: Active if you already played a card of the same faction this round.

armed.name: Armed
armed.reminder: Works if you have at least one Relic in play.

haunted.name: Haunted
haunted.reminder: Works if your graveyard has at least 5 cards.

ui.chain: Chain (from the last card to the first):
ui.chooseResponse: The opponent acted. Do you want to respond with a Quick Rite?
ui.invalid: Invalid choice. Type a number from the list.

ui.mulliganHint: Choose the cards to replace, then confirm.
ui.moveHint: Click one of your Keepers to move it (1 Ember).
ui.keysHint: Keyboard: Tab to move, Enter to choose, P to pass or confirm, Esc to cancel, I (or right click) for the card sheet.

keepers.title: Keepers and Beacons
keepers.intro: Play a Keeper in the Front row. A new Keeper does not attack in its first round. In the next round, the Keeper attacks the enemy Beacon in its lane.

blocking.title: Blocking and Reach
blocking.intro: An enemy Keeper attacks your Beacon A. A Keeper in the Front row blocks and hits back. A Keeper with Reach also attacks from the Back row.

ember.title: Ember and Reserve
ember.intro: Each card costs Ember. At the end of a round you keep up to 2 Ember in the Reserve. The Reserve adds to your Ember in the next round.
ember.goal: Put out two enemy Beacons with Rites.

tide.title: The Tide
tide.intro: Some cards move the Tide toward you. With the Tide on your side by 2 or more, High Tide effects work.

chain.title: Responses and the chain
chain.intro: The opponent plays a Rite against your Keeper. Respond with a Quick Rite. The chain resolves from the last card to the first.
chain.goal: Save your Keeper and win the game.
